options.plain_language_summary: Keep paying $531/mo for 42 more months. About $2,195 of interest remains.
options.key_assumption: Current payment and APR unchanged.
options.tradeoff: No savings, no risk.

options.plain_language_summary: Refinance $20,097 at 5.60% for the same 42 months: $528/mo (-3) and about $115 less total interest.
options.key_assumption: Refi APR from rate sheet for tier A; same remaining term; no fees.
options.tradeoff: New credit check; only worth it if the rate drops enough.

options.plain_language_summary: Lower payment to $425/mo (-106) but pay about $639 MORE in total interest.
options.key_assumption: Same APR, +12 months.
options.tradeoff: Relief now costs more later; keeps you in the loan longer.

options.plain_language_summary: Paying $631/mo finishes 7 months sooner and saves about $381 in interest.
options.key_assumption: Extra goes to principal; no prepayment penalty.
options.tradeoff: Less monthly cash flexibility.

options.plain_language_summary: Move the due date to match payday. Same payment, same total cost. Done in the app in about a minute.
options.key_assumption: Allowed once per 12 months; may add or remove a few days of interest.
options.tradeoff: None for most customers.

options.plain_language_summary: Skip one payment. About $99 of interest is added and the loan ends 1 month later.
options.key_assumption: One deferral per 12 months; must be reviewed by a specialist.
options.tradeoff: Interest still builds; the missed amount is not forgiven.

options.option_name: Trade in toward a new Toyota
options.plain_language_summary: Estimated value $22,900 vs payoff $20,097: equity of $2,803.
options.key_assumption: Market value is an estimate; dealer appraisal decides the final number.
options.tradeoff: Positive equity can lower a new payment; negative equity gets rolled into the new loan.

situation.customer_says: My Highlander lease ends in 2 months and I want to keep it. What does buying it cost?
situation.context_summary: Lease ends in 2 months; wants to keep the car

options.option_name: Return the car at lease end
options.plain_language_summary: Projected 31,500 miles vs 36,000 allowed: about $0 excess-mileage charge plus $395 turn-in fee.
options.key_assumption: $0.25/mile over; $395 disposition fee.
options.tradeoff: Nothing owned afterwards.

options.option_name: Buy the car at lease end
options.plain_language_summary: Buyout is $28,550 (residual plus $350 fee). Estimated market value is $33,800, so you would be $5,250 ahead.
options.key_assumption: Taxes and registration extra; financing rate from tier table.
options.tradeoff: Over-the-mileage fee goes away if you buy.

options.option_name: Loyalty move into a new Toyota lease
options.plain_language_summary: Early or on-time renewal with Toyota waives the turn-in fee and the excess-mileage charge (synthetic loyalty rule).
options.key_assumption: Capped at $1,500 waived.
options.tradeoff: New payment depends on the model; you start a new contract.

options.plain_language_summary: Keep the same payment for up to 6 more months to buy time.
options.key_assumption: Same payment; mileage allowance increases pro rata.

options.plain_language_summary: Estimated early-termination cost about $834 (35% of remaining payments plus fee).

options.tradeoff: Usually costly. Transfer or renewal can be cheaper.
